data.standardized_narrative: For the 2015 calendar year, Syndicate 2010 experienced a net release of $7.790 million in prior year reserves. This was driven by a release of $41.232 million related to the 2013 and prior underwriting years (2001-2012), partially offset by a strengthening of $33.442 million for the 2014 underwriting year. The report notes that prior closed years generally ran off satisfactorily, with releases from all but one year.
raw_causal_phrases: Prior closed years continue to run off satisfactorily both in the aggregate and individually, with all years but one contributing releases to the closing year result.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development is calculated from the 'Gross claims incurred' breakdown by year of account in the calendar year results table, where positive values indicate releases and negative values indicate strengthenings. The negative gross premium for 'Motor (third party liability)' is reported as stated in the document.
